content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Syracuse

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review your academic credentials and work history against PMI's stated requirements to ensure you qualify. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can guide you through this verification step before registration.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend all classroom sessions synchronously, engage with real-time case studies, and participate in instructor-led discussions—all from your Syracuse location, on a schedule that fits your work commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your formal PMI application and pay the associated exam fee directly to the Project Management Institute. Granite PM Academy provides clear guidance on required documentation and deadlines to keep your application on track.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study materials, to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your proctored PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center and sit for the four-hour assessment at your own pace and location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you'll enter PMI's three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional involvement. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Syracuse's healthcare, advanced manufacturing, defense, and higher-education sectors.
